## Generations – Karl and Kelt Studer


**Karl Studer has built his life doing linework and is now serving as President of Electric Power for Quanta Services. His son, Kelt, is a recent graduate of Northwest Lineman College, just beginning his career.**


When a tradesman passes the torch to the next generation, what does he say?
